parameters.formDescription: Upload a ContaGen contacts CSV. Its contacts load as Source 1; Supersoniq then pulls more decision-makers at the same domains. Both upsert into the client's ClayRoots build table. Targeting defaults overshoot on purpose; narrow only if you mean to.

values.fieldLabel: Seniority levels (default net pre-ticked; untick to narrow)

values.placeholder: tblXXXXXXXXXXXXXX — leave empty to create a new table
Optional label for this build — written onto every row

nodes.name: Strip Immutable (S1)
nodes.notes: Removes Build Date and Run ID from the payload. Build Date is a computed CREATED_TIME() field; writing it 422s and previously re-stamped existing rows on every append. Run ID dropped by Operator decision 2026-08-09.

nodes.name: Strip Immutable (S2)
nodes.notes: Removes Build Date and Run ID from the payload. Build Date is a computed CREATED_TIME() field; writing it 422s and previously re-stamped existing rows on every append. Run ID dropped by Operator decision 2026-08-09.

nodes.name: Overflow Set
nodes.notes: Retains the list of domains Supersoniq returned no contact for. Build Log only ever kept the count.

folderId.value: ={{ $('Create Overflow Folder').isExecuted ? $('Create Overflow Folder').first().json.id : $('Find Overflow Folder').all().filter(i => i.json.name === 'Leads Overflow').map(i => i.json.id)[0] }}

nodes.name: Overflow Log Note
nodes.notes: Never throws. Announces the overflow report on the run log, success or failure.
